en.headline: Two drivers arrested after parking row turns violent in Yau Tong
en.dek: A mixer-truck driver and a minibus driver were detained after a dispute near Sam Ka Tsuen Ferry Pier on Wednesday evening; one man was treated for a head injury.
body: Police arrested two men after a parking dispute near Sam Ka Tsuen Ferry Pier in Yau Tong escalated into an assault on Wednesday evening.

Officers said they received reports at about 6.30pm of a fight on Shung Shun Street. A 51-year-old concrete-mixer driver is suspected of striking a 69-year-old minibus driver with a metal pole about one metre long. Police said the older man had also shoved the other driver during the argument.

The mixer-truck driver was arrested on suspicion of assault occasioning actual bodily harm. The minibus driver was arrested on suspicion of common assault and taken to United Christian Hospital with a head injury. Police said he was conscious and in a stable condition. The case is being handled by Kwun Tong District Crime Squad 1.

zh.headline: 油塘泊車爭執兩司機被捕 一人頭部受傷
zh.dek: 周三傍晚三家村碼頭對開因泊車起衝突，田螺車司機涉嫌以鐵通打傷小巴司機，兩人分別涉襲擊罪被捕。
body: 油塘崇信街三家村碼頭對開周三傍晚發生司機爭執，兩名男子其後被捕，其中一人頭部受傷送院。
警方表示，約晚上6晃30分接報有人打架。初步調查相信，一名51歲混凝土車司機涉嫌用約一米長鐵通襲擊一名69歲小巴司機，小巴司機其間亦曾以身體碰撞對方。
混凝土車司機涉嫌襲擊致造成身體傷害被捕，小巴司機則涉嫌普通襲擊被捕，頭部受傷清醒送往基督教聯合醫院，情況穩定。案件由觀塘警區刑事調查隊第一隊跟進。
